October 4, 1932.

Memorandum on the movements of V.A. Doobonosoff,
Soviet Employee

V.A. Doobonosoff, manager of the local branch
of the Far Eastern Bank (Dalbank) who left Shanghai
on September 2, 1932 for Tsingtao, returned here on
October 1, 1932 by the s.s. "Hoten Maru." He was
accompanied by his wife and child. Doobonosoff
who is 32 years of age resides at the Park Apartments
Flat 20, 455 Rue Lafayette.

G Tcheremshansky
D. S.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3436.
Date. 1. / 4. / 32.

Special Branch S.2.
April 1, 1932.

Memorandum on movements of A. Doobonosoff,
Soviet employee.

This individual arrived in Shanghai from
Dairen by the s.s. "Hoten Maru" on March 21, 1932.
It is reported that he has been appointed to the
post of manager of the local branch of the Far
Eastern Bank (Dalbank), No.3 Foochow Road, in
place of S.S. Tselooshoff, who has been acting as
substitute manager since April, 1931, following
the departure to Russia of Mr. Skripkoff the
former manager.

Efforts are made to locate his place of
residence.

G. Tcheremshanoff
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch
Information.

1932年4月1日。

关于苏联雇员 A. Doobonosoff 行踪的备忘录。

此人于1932年3月21日乘“Hoten Maru”号轮船从大连抵达上海。
据报，他已被任命为福州路3号远东银行（Dalbank）上海分行经理，接替 S.S. Tselooshoff 的职务；自1931年4月前任经理 Skripkoff 先生离境赴俄以来，Tselooshoff 一直担任代理经理。

正设法查明其住址。

G. Tcheremshanoff
D. S.
